nodes.title: Creative Arts: Visual Arts
nodes.description: Visual Arts for Grade 8 with deeper exploration of media and techniques, art history spanning African and European traditions, critical analysis and independent creative expression.

nodes.title: Term 1
nodes.description: Term 1: Perspective drawing and spatial representation; Impressionism and Post-Impressionism.

nodes.title: Drawing — Perspective and Space
nodes.description: Linear perspective: one-point and two-point perspective; vanishing point, horizon line; drawing interior and exterior architectural spaces; foreshortening; depth and spatial illusion. Art history: Renaissance perspective — Brunelleschi, Da Vinci; comparing to flat African pictorial space. Practical task: architectural or environmental drawing using perspective.

nodes.title: Painting — Impressionism and Colour
nodes.description: Impressionist techniques: broken colour, visible brushwork, capturing light; outdoor painting from observation; atmospheric perspective; colour temperature and mood. Art history: Monet, Renoir, Pissarro — Impressionism; Irma Stern as South African Expressionist. Practical task: landscape or still-life painting in an Impressionist style.

nodes.title: Term 2
nodes.description: Term 2: Figure drawing and the human form; African and global sculptural traditions.

nodes.title: Drawing — The Human Figure
nodes.description: Human proportion and anatomy basics; gesture drawing and movement; observational figure drawing; portrait drawing: proportions of the face, features, expression; figure in context and narrative. Art history: figurative art across cultures — Egyptian, Greek, African. Practical task: figure drawing or portrait study.

nodes.title: 3D Art — Sculpture and Modelling
nodes.description: Sculpture techniques: modelling in clay or papier-mâché; additive and subtractive methods; texture, form and surface treatment; mask-making; African sculptural traditions — Yoruba, Benin bronzes, Makonde. Contemporary South African sculptors: Willie Bester, Andries Botha. Practical task: sculptural mask or figure using clay or papier-mâché.

nodes.title: Term 3
nodes.description: Term 3: Printmaking and screen printing; Cubism and abstraction in 20th century art.

nodes.title: Printmaking — Monoprint and Screen Printing
nodes.description: Monoprint techniques: painted plate, transfer methods; introduction to screen printing concepts; stencil printing; colour registration in multi-colour prints; texture and surface in printmaking. Art history: Andy Warhol — Pop Art screen printing; South African printmakers: Judith Mason. Practical task: monoprint or stencil print series.

nodes.title: Painting — Abstraction and Cubism
nodes.description: Abstract art: non-representational art; Cubism — multiple viewpoints, fragmented forms, Picasso, Braque; geometric abstraction; abstract expressionism; interpreting and creating abstract compositions. South African abstract artists. Practical task: abstract composition inspired by Cubist principles.

nodes.title: Term 4
nodes.description: Term 4: Digital art and photography; contemporary and street art; portfolio exhibition.

nodes.title: Photography and Digital Art
nodes.description: Photography as art: composition, framing, light; camera phone photography; basic photo editing and manipulation; digital collage; graphic design using free digital tools. Photojournalism and documentary photography — David Goldblatt, Jodi Bieber. Practical task: photo essay or digital artwork on a social theme.

nodes.title: Street Art, Murals and Portfolio Exhibition
nodes.description: Street art and murals as public art; graffiti art and its social messages; community mural projects; analysing street art for meaning and technique. Portfolio compilation and exhibition: selecting best work, writing artist statements, presenting work; peer and self-evaluation.
